is: The voice a place's people play, worked out from its design, never a list of places or people (score/stages/sound): wherever the place's picked design stands people (data/people/rows.json), the first of `by_hearing` whose `heard` and `air` fit how the scene is heard (score/stages/sound/beds.py facts: a room on a body with sealed air is a station module, crew_talk; a room in breathable air room_talk; the open air outdoor_chatter; through a suit helmet_radio_talk), else `people`, plays on its first person, at /<place>/Characters/<name>. Each names a library brief of data/sound/sounds.json, made fresh in the batch, one take every place hearing it alike shares (takes.held), and a take that does not come back is a batch gap on each place's first person. What the people say (a speech, a radio call) is not in the design, so no rule here picks it.
